project.title: Microbial communities within an urban mass transit system
project.description: This dataset contains 96 sequences from train cars and subway stations across the Boston subway system: 72 sequences consist of the V4 amplicons of the 16S rRNA genes and 24 sequences are shotgun metagenomic sequences.
